name: teledrive
description: Open-source self-hosted API-first file manager backed by a user's Telegram private storage channel.

scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && python -m celery -A app.worker.tasks worker --loglevel=info --pool=solo -n teledrive-dev
scripts.dev:beat: cd apps/api && python -m celery -A app.worker.tasks beat --loglevel=info
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace packages/shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/shared
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace packages/shared
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && cd apps/api && python -m pytest -q
